nodes.g: to draw off, draw out, withdraw, rescue, deliver
nodes.klein: to draw off, draw out, withdraw, rescue, deliver. he drew, drew off; he withdrew. was rescued, was delivered; he had the ceremony of ‘Halitzah’ performed on himself. he pulled out, tore out; he rescued, delivered. was pulled out, was torn out; was rescued, was delivered. was withdrawn, was removed.
